name: bao-flash-browser
description: Cross-platform Flash browser based on Electron

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:css-fixer && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:main && npm run typecheck:renderer && npm run typecheck:preload
scripts.check: npm run i18n && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test -- --run && npm run build
scripts.start: npm run i18n && npm run build && electron .
scripts.build:win64: npm run build && npm run verify:release -- --stage source --platform win32 --arch x64 && npm run prepare:release && cross-env BAO_TARGET_PLATFORM=win32 BAO_TARGET_ARCH=x64 ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --publish never && npm run verify:release -- --stage unpacked --platform win32 --arch x64
scripts.build:win32: npm run build && npm run verify:release -- --stage source --platform win32 --arch ia32 && npm run prepare:release && cross-env BAO_TARGET_PLATFORM=win32 BAO_TARGET_ARCH=ia32 ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.config.cjs --win --ia32 --publish never && npm run verify:release -- --stage unpacked --platform win32 --arch ia32
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && npm run verify:release -- --stage source --platform linux --arch x64 && npm run prepare:release && cross-env BAO_TARGET_PLATFORM=linux BAO_TARGET_ARCH=x64 ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --x64 --publish never && npm run verify:release -- --stage unpacked --platform linux --arch x64
scripts.build:all: npm run build:win64 && npm run build:win32 && npm run build:linux
scripts.test:css-fixer: npm run build:css-fixer && node tests/electron/build-userscript-runtime-smoke.mjs && node tests/electron/build-userscripts-admin-smoke.mjs && electron tests/electron/userscript-css-fixer-smoke.cjs

author: Sutanm
